description: Estimate the credits to dub one video into one or more languages (speech-to-text + translation + voice + video merge) before running localize_video. Pass video_url (duration is measured) or duration_seconds.

targets.description: One entry per target language (the server allows 10 per job by default).

language.description: Target language code, e.g. en, es, ja.

voice.description: Voice token (v1:...) for that language from list_voices / favorites / custom voices.

name: estimate_video_localization
title: Estimate video dubbing cost
